name: Beacon Cottage Farm Touring Park
accommodation: 60 level grass pitches in six small paddocks, some with sea views, plus six serviced hardstandings
suitableFor: Tent campers, caravanners and motorhomers wanting a quiet clifftop base
dogs: Listed as dog friendly by Visit Cornwall
beachAccess: A few hundred yards from the sea; Visit Cornwall states Chapel Porth beach is about a 15-minute walk by footpath; St Agnes village 1.5 miles
confirmedFeatures: Refitted toilet and shower blocks, laundry, play area, WiFi, sea views, open April to October
overview: A working farm touring park on the cliffs between St Agnes Beacon and Wheal Coates, a few hundred yards from the sea. Pitches are spread across six small landscaped paddocks, some open to sea views and others more sheltered. Chapel Porth is reached on foot by footpath, and St Agnes village is about a mile and a half away.
surfTripFit: Campers can walk to Chapel Porth for a surf and are a short drive from Trevaunance Cove and Porthtowan.
